scope: Dive Enter follows the priced next action: approach, reveal-only sonar, deliberate Study, one physical return step, recovery or battery recharge. Collection stays separate and optional. A sorted browser exposes six nearest resolved sonar contacts; free selection plots the genuine contact, closes the picker and returns the panel to its primary action. Suggested sites compare real purpose, certification use and approximate movement costs. Several deliberate studies and finite collections can share one dive. Recovery reports actual elapsed deployment-to-recovery time, hull change and net held cargo, with no extra payout. The chart has a smaller panel-open objective card, fewer repeated biology labels and an offscreen buoy bearing.
